acceptances.exact_acceptance: 한 모드의 여러 pack과 의존 모드가 정상 해석되고 실제 선택 결과에 모두 나타나며, 같은 파일 수라도 선언된 모드 경계가 판정을 소유한다.
acceptances.independent_reasoning: Mod ownership is explicit in the registry. Dependency closure and pack receipts remain grouped by mod, including multi-pack selection; file count never substitutes for the declared ownership graph.

acceptances.exact_acceptance: 한 구성원의 검증 실패·누락·중복 소유·dependency cycle은 그 모드의 부분 적용을 만들지 않고 원래 선택과 다른 정상 모드의 기록을 보존한다.
acceptances.independent_reasoning: Schema bounds, unique ownership and acyclic closure are validated before candidate publication. Independent bad/dependent/good selections retain distinct records and do not publish a partial bad mod.

acceptances.exact_acceptance: 새 외부 RON의 정상 validate→trial 준비→실제 명령 실행이 같은 content/profile identity를 보존하고 아직 승인하지 않은 후보는 host Apply에서 거절된다.
acceptances.independent_reasoning: Candidate stores immutable original bytes and compiles the exact effective selection. Trial and final authority bind this identity; the ordinary host takes opaque issued authority, not a public success DTO. Literal release CLI and real server evidence reach the consumers.

acceptances.exact_acceptance: 파싱·지원 capability·참조·compile·준비 실패 및 취소는 새 세대/승인/실게임 변경을 남기지 않으며 private fixture 없이 default-release 공개 경로에서 확인된다.
acceptances.independent_reasoning: Acquisition, support, compile, setup and cancellation failures leave no issued authority or applied generation. Supervised workers preserve incomplete/setup failure categories. Default-release probes use actual external RON; test-only constructors are supplementary.

acceptances.exact_acceptance: 정상 및 실제 확장 부하에서 선택한 스킬/유물/생성물·연쇄의 실제 발동·소비·종료를 관찰하고 workload 규모/seed/경로 coverage를 결과에 결속한다.
acceptances.independent_reasoning: Coverage obligations enumerate changed/required definitions and actual consumer stages, including causal site kind/index and source copy. Positive A13/B17 chains, independent object/terminal/recipe/causal/resource probes and realized workloads provide nonzero consumption. The 500/1000 cases expand roster assets, with eight deployed actors, not 500/1000 combatants.

acceptances.exact_acceptance: 대상이 없거나 trigger가 실행되지 않은 경우, 필수 scenario 누락 및 setup 자체의 한도 실패가 구별되어 승인되지 않으며 콘텐츠가 아직 실행되지 않은 setup 실패를 스킬 결함으로 표시하지 않는다.
acceptances.independent_reasoning: Missing target, untriggered required sites, unsupported/zero sites and absent scenarios remain incomplete. Setup failure is recorded before content execution and cannot become a content-failure diagnosis or approval. Negative recipe target guards precede proc roll and mutation.

acceptances.exact_acceptance: 실제 대표 정상/확장 원시 측정과 근거 있는 구체 기준을 가진 profile로 정상 공개 Lab→Apply가 완료되며 profile/config/측정·기준 identity를 조회할 수 있다.
acceptances.independent_reasoning: Actual paired plain/native worker data cover all four phases and three repeats. Versioned criterion adoption is bound to owner binary/source/compiler/profile/suite and consumed by the same normal Lab-to-Apply path. The current normal-save, server, Core, launcher, server-process, successor and expression contexts have scoped raw/adoption evidence.

acceptances.exact_acceptance: 유효 측정의 정확한 합격선과 초과 사례에서 의도한 허용/거부가 갈리고, 기준 미정·근거 부재·위조 profile·다른 profile 증거·저사양 완화 시도는 승인되지 않는다.
acceptances.independent_reasoning: The sealed criterion has no arbitrary public deserialization authority. Actual calibration precedes exact/one-over supplemental comparator tests for elapsed, heap, RSS and native work. The measured A+B case actually exceeds native 233000000 at 234667723 while individuals pass; rejected management inputs cannot lower the criterion.

acceptances.exact_acceptance: 동일 입력/seed/profile의 반복은 정해진 gameplay 결과를 유지하고 실제 sample 수·분포·peak·종료 후 회수 및 각 지표·계측 모드의 범위가 원시 결과와 맞는다.
acceptances.independent_reasoning: Plain/native semantic parity compares actual result and coverage records, repeats and phase completion. RAW_OBSERVATIONS records independent raw maxima and end-live allocations; native accounting, allocator peak and OS RSS remain distinct. Plain native zero denotes instrumentation absence.

acceptances.exact_acceptance: 수집 중단·한도·missing/drop·관측 미지원·미완료를 PASS 또는 콘텐츠 오동작으로 바꾸지 않고 원인/진행 지점을 보존하며 관측 on/off가 gameplay 결과를 바꾸지 않는다.
acceptances.independent_reasoning: Worker timeout/output limits, absent metrics, missing/drop/uncertain/overflow and unsupported coverage remain incomplete with causes. Neither diagnostic output nor a partial sample can mint authority. Paired collection compares semantic results rather than elapsed equality.

acceptances.exact_acceptance: 첫 적용의 실제 검증 후 같은 주체·동일 입력은 유효 캐시를 재사용하고, 내용/의존/조합/engine/profile/suite 변경은 해당 승인을 무효화하여 새 검증 없이는 Apply하지 않는다.
acceptances.independent_reasoning: Cache authentication covers the subject and exact candidate/environment/profile/suite identity. Real first-validation and subsequent reuse tests are distinguished. Installation identity includes compiler/dependency/features and executable pair; changed contexts invalidate rather than relabel old results.

acceptances.exact_acceptance: 복사한 다른 주체 기록·PASS 문자열·변조/손상/부분 캐시·선택 후 입력 변경과 stale 결과는 거절되며 기존 유효 기록과 실게임 상태를 오염시키지 않는다.
acceptances.independent_reasoning: Private root ownership, no-follow handling, HMAC domains, bounded record parsing and subject identity reject copied/forged/corrupt/partial data. Candidate bytes are immutable and issuer revision checks prevent changed selection or stale completion from publishing.

acceptances.exact_acceptance: 실패 mod·의존 mod·독립 정상 mod가 섞인 선택에서 각각 실패/보류/유효 기록이 구별되고 승인 가능한 별도 선택을 실제 검증하여 적용할 수 있다.
acceptances.independent_reasoning: Individual validation resolves each mod with its dependency closure. Failed, dependency-held and independently valid outcomes stay separate; successful independent selection is rebuilt and actually validated before Apply.

acceptances.exact_acceptance: 개별 PASS 두 mod가 함께 실행될 때만 실제 충돌·기준 초과가 나는 조합은 그 조합만 막고 개별 기록을 보존하며, 재선택의 Replace/Remove·winner 결과가 제외된 mod의 잔여 효과 없이 다시 계산된다.
acceptances.independent_reasoning: Final combination is a separate job over a fresh resolution. Actual individual successes and measured combination failure are preserved. Selected winners are not silently projected after removal; stale winner errors remain refusal, and effective Replace/Remove resolution starts from the immutable base.

acceptances.exact_acceptance: 정상 Lab 승인→host Apply→실제 새 run의 명령/조회가 승인한 새 content를 소비하고 기존 run은 자기 이전 generation의 동작을 유지한다.
acceptances.independent_reasoning: Apply installs only the approved future generation under the host installation lock. Active A is an Arc-pinned generation; ordinary StartNewGame consumes future B. Actual actor transport and durable B-after-C tests exercise these distinct consumers.

acceptances.exact_acceptance: 승인 없는/낡은/변조된 후보와 마지막 게시 전 검증 실패를 거절해 기존 상태·seed·generation·저장을 보존한다. 검증 후 원본 파일이 바뀌어도 승인받은 immutable 세대만 적용하거나 재검증으로 거부하며 failed B를 A 적용 성공으로 보고하지 않는다.
acceptances.independent_reasoning: Issuer and installation checks happen before publication. Accepted-v2 persistence binds exact old/new configuration at the acceptance boundary. Changed original files cannot mutate the candidate. Failed/stale candidate and preaccept failures retain previous generation and durable bytes; success does not fall back to A.

acceptances.exact_acceptance: 실제 취소·선택 변경과 늦은 검증 완료, 같은 결과 재전달에서 승인/Apply 수명과 정확 한 번의 게시가 유지된다.
acceptances.independent_reasoning: Job revision, cancellation and live issuer identity are checked at publication. Duplicate accepted delivery is idempotent; re-selection and late completion cannot acquire current authority. Barrier-driven tests cover cancellation/stale races and accepted recovery.

acceptances.exact_acceptance: 캐시 쓰기 중단·부분 기록·읽기 손상·재시작과 retry를 통해 잘못된 승인 부활이 없고 원래 유효 cache/현재 generation과 개인 저장을 보존한다.
acceptances.independent_reasoning: Cache preaccept failures preserve prior state, while accepted rename followed by sync failure is recovery pending and replayable under exact authority. Restart tests distinguish those states, reject partial/corrupt data and avoid reissuing arbitrary authority.

acceptances.exact_acceptance: 정상 승인 구성의 새 게임/저장/fresh Continue는 동일 content와 진행을 복원하며 다른 호환 저장과 독립 세션은 계속 사용할 수 있다.
acceptances.independent_reasoning: ApprovedPersistence binds current required content and each active actor requirement. Actual fresh Continue restores the saved approved configuration; the held B actor saves after C is current and a fresh B reader consumes that actual save.

acceptances.exact_acceptance: 필수 mod 누락/불합격/승인 stale 또는 content 불일치 load를 거절해 원본·backup·profile/active 저장을 보존하고 필요한 mod/구성 이유를 안내한다. 필요한 승인 구성을 복구하면 같은 원본 save가 정상 복원된다.
acceptances.independent_reasoning: Preflight checks active, backup, accepted intent and profile before writer-capable recovery. Missing/stale/mismatched requirements protect original bytes; same-original-save tests recover the required approved set and Continue the identical original. Unsupported legacy formats retain inherited protected-original behavior.

acceptances.exact_acceptance: 승인 구성의 실제 live battle에 safety fault를 유발하면 원래 U03 fault query/gate와 결과·저장 차단·다른 actor 독립성이 유지된다.
acceptances.independent_reasoning: The current expression actor accepts a real cast and reaches DivideByZero at Evaluate/host_tick after ordinary readiness. Its public state/resources/facts and durable bytes stay fixed, later mutation/tick is gated, and an unrelated actor continues and saves. Inherited U03 evidence retains the full private-root/RNG atomicity oracle.

acceptances.exact_acceptance: 일반 입력 거절·Lab 준비 실패·수집 실패와 live battle terminal fault를 구분하며 진단 실패/재접속/늦은 callback도 기존 fault를 정상 완료로 바꾸지 않는다.
acceptances.independent_reasoning: Command refusal and Lab setup/collector incomplete are distinct from a published battle fault. First-cause identity survives reconnect, repeats, B Apply and stop; only the permitted fresh actor Continue restores the valid pre-fault save. Admission cannot clear A fault.

acceptances.exact_acceptance: default-release 외부 입력으로 로컬 Core/CLI와 실제 서버 bootstrap 또는 공개 관리 경계에서 승인된 조합을 생성·적용하고 실제 gameplay/query에 도달한다.
acceptances.independent_reasoning: Default-release mod_launcher and real game_server bootstrap each own normal validation and Apply. Literal external smoke includes real WebSocket authentication, StartNewGame, restart and Continue; actual raw child logs were independently hashed. Diagnostic direct Core use is not counted as admission.

acceptances.exact_acceptance: 권한 없는 요청·잘못된 입력·미완료/실패/정상 상태가 typed 진단으로 구별되고 서버와 로컬의 approval/설정 소유가 서로 혼동되지 않는다.
acceptances.independent_reasoning: Issuer identity is process/subject scoped; server and local roots are independent. Typed invalid launcher/server inputs fail with their recorded nonzero exits. Opaque handles and normal bootstrap prevent a DTO PASS string or unauthorized query from creating authority.

acceptances.exact_acceptance: 현재 지원 기능의 실제 profile/coverage와 한계를 조회하고 새 capability 또는 규칙 revision이 필요한 검증을 빠뜨리면 Apply가 보류된다.
acceptances.independent_reasoning: Suite and capability revisions plus per-site coverage are part of validation identity. Unsupported or uncovered changed content cannot pass even if its setup runs. Queryable reports show profile/coverage and explicit bounded support; diagnosis has no approval capability.

acceptances.exact_acceptance: 같은 유효 입력의 evidence는 근거대로 재사용하되 영향받는 변경과 default/development 차이는 정확히 invalidate되어 이전 FAIL을 새 PASS로 소급 변경하지 않는다.
acceptances.independent_reasoning: Evidence reuse is claim-specific, using actual source-archive comparisons and binary/owner context. Product-identical late builds are current; earlier semantic consumers have independently reviewed nonimpact plus affected-path supplements. Old failed contexts and default/development profiles retain their original identities.

acceptances.exact_acceptance: 반복 및 독립 두 검증/게임 세션에서 성공·취소·실패·clone 이후 각 결과와 profile이 분리되고 actual peak 및 종료 후 회수 근거가 남는다.
acceptances.independent_reasoning: Issuer, generation and trial weak-owner tests check last-owner release and isolation. Actual paired phase measurements include peak and drop-live observations; current actor tests pin A while other sessions progress. No claim of zero process allocator retention is made.

acceptances.exact_acceptance: 수집/캐시/작업 상한·진단 포화에서도 메모리와 출력이 유한하며 live generation 수명·기존 결과 및 다른 세션의 진행을 바꾸지 않는다.
acceptances.independent_reasoning: Finite registry/jobs/cache/coverage/worker input-output/repeat limits bound administrative work. Diagnostic saturation cannot create approval or change gameplay. Arc ownership allows active generations to outlive the host current pointer, with last-owner release tested.

acceptances.exact_acceptance: 현재 수용 조건·필수차원·영향받는 선행 조건에 실제 nonzero 실행 또는 명시 current 재사용과 실패 원본이 연결되고 calibration/Apply의 실제 정상 종단 근거가 있다.
acceptances.independent_reasoning: Thirty exact acceptance sentences, twenty seams, ten dimensions, three nodes and all 316 predecessor rows have evidence and independent semantic dispositions here. Named tests, external functional probes, measurement and management records stay distinct; preserved failed attempts are not counted as successful runs.

acceptances.exact_acceptance: 역할을 분리한 전체 독립 Complete/High/open0와 격리 복원/현재성 근거가 존재하며 전체 suite 미실행 자체나 기능 일부 PASS를 전체 판정으로 대체하지 않는다.
acceptances.independent_reasoning: This is a fresh nonparticipant whole-Goal audit after writer/runner closure. Actual isolated forward/reverse restoration and independent archive/member/hash checks bind the target; entry/exit checks detect changes. No full-suite rerun is inferred or required solely from freshness, and no partial test set substitutes for the whole semantic verdict.
